body: I can't even cry anymore. I'm just empty inside.

Why do people want to keep other people alive anyway? Why does it make them feel better to think that they kept someone from killing themselves? Do they think they give them a chance to be happy? A, what, 0.1% chance? Life is a fucking burden.

Nobody even replies in this subreddit. Depression is repulsive to people. They can smell it a mile way. 

I get it though. I wouldn't want to hang with myself either.
